z: 踰 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child does not need a conversation performed. A child needs a person who can be found. Being findable is the practice. The words can come later, or not.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 踰 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 踴 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Forgiveness does not require the betrayed to be foolish. It requires them to decide whether the person is still a member. Membership is a practice after it has been a wound.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 踴 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 踵 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A marriage that has lost a child, or a parent, or a future, needs presence more than explanation. Explanation is a way of leaving. Sitting is a way of staying.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 踵 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Bring food. Take the lower seat. Stay past the moment you become uncomfortable.

z: 踶 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A marriage in despair does not need a speech about gratitude. It needs one true plan for tomorrow that both people can bear. Make the plan small enough to be kept.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 踶 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 踹 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
In a marriage, revenge is often petty and therefore easy to excuse. The small cut, repeated, is how love is replaced by a contest. Mercy is leaving one cut unanswered.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 踹 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 踽 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 踽 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 蹂 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 蹂 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

z: 蹄 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 蹄 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 蹇 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 蹇 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 蹈 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 蹈 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Feed the guest, or the youngest, before you take your own share.

z: 蹉 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. 蹉 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 蹊 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 蹊 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 蹋 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 蹋 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 蹌 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 蹌 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 蹐 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. 蹐 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 蹔 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 蹔 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 蹕 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 蹕 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If a child is carrying a feud that belongs to adults, take it back. Say that it is not theirs.

z: 蹙 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 蹙 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 蹟 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 蹟 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 蹠 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 蹠 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 蹢 umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umphimbo, izintambo zezwi, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu. 蹢 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 蹣 umsipha wesifuba, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 蹣 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 蹤 umsipha wesifuba, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 蹤 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 蹬 umsipha wesifuba, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 蹬 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 蹭 umsipha wesifuba, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 蹭 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 蹯 umsipha wesifuba, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 蹯 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 蹰 umsipha wesifuba, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 蹰 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 蹲 umsipha wesifuba, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 蹲 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 蹴 umsipha wesifuba, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 蹴 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 蹶 umsipha wesifuba, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 蹶 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 蹻 umsipha wesifuba, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 蹻 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 蹼 umsipha wesifuba, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 蹼 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 躁 umsipha wesifuba, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 躁 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 躄 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 躄 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 躅 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 躅 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 躇 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 躇 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 躊 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 躊 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 躋 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 躋 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 躍 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 躍 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 躑 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 躑 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 躓 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 躓 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 躔 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 躔 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 躘 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 躘 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 躙 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. 躙 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 躞 umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 躞 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

z: 躡 umsipha wesifuba, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 躡 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 躪 umsipha wesifuba, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

This is the work between siblings. Here the body speaks by umsipha wesifuba, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 躪 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 躬 umsipha wesifuba, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

line:
A child does not need a conversation performed. A child needs a person who can be found. Being findable is the practice. The words can come later, or not.

line:

practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

line:

z: 輪 imisipha, ubambo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:

line:

z: 輭 imisipha, ubambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 輶 imisipha, ubambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 輹 imisipha, ubambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 輻 imisipha, ubambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 輾 imisipha, ubambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 輿 imisipha, ubambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 轀 imisipha, ubambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 轂 imisipha, ubambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 轄 imisipha, ubambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

z: 轅 imisipha, ubambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

z: 轉 imisipha, ubambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 轊 imisipha, ubambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

z: 轎 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

z: 轔 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 轗 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 轜 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

z: 轟 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

z: 轡 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

z: 轣 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 轤 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 辛 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

z: 辜 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

z: 辞 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

z: 辟 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

z: 辣 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work between siblings. The member drawn is umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 辣 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.

z: 辤 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 辦 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 辨 umgubuzelo wamaphaphu, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

z: 迷 udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Name the break once, plainly, without the extra charges that make you feel righteous. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and do it again tomorrow. Trust is rebuilt at that size.

This is the work between siblings. udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 迷 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 迸 udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Do not correct a grieving person into cheer. Bring food. Take the lower seat. Let the name of the absent be said. The name is how the absent remain in the family.

This is the work between siblings. udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 迸 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 迹 udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it. The gesture is small, and it is the whole teaching.

This is the work between siblings. udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 迹 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 迺 udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Do one undeserved kindness to the person you are keeping score against. Do not mention the score. The mention would turn the kindness back into a move.

This is the work between siblings. udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 迺 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: If a child is carrying a feud that belongs to adults, take it back. Say that it is not theirs.

z: 迻 udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
The counsel that lasted did not flatter rage. It asked the strong to become a wall for the weak. That is the ethic of a parent and of an elder: your size is a shelter, or it is a threat.

This is the work between siblings. udonga lwesisu, umsipha ongaphandle wesisu, umsipha ongaphakathi wesisu, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 迻 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 追 ingqe eqhuma, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The old wisdom is severe on the high seat. It is not severe on the upright spine. Stand up. Then let the others stand. A house of one standing person is a court, not a family.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 追 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 退 ingqe eqhuma, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child who is envied by a parent carries a weight no child can name. Admiration from above is a kind of safety. It says, your becoming does not threaten my place.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 退 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 送 ingqe eqhuma, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A child learns courage from a body that does not abandon the feeling. Sit until the breath slows. Explanation can wait. Presence cannot.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 送 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 适 ingqe eqhuma, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children do not need every desire answered. They need to see a hand open. The open hand is their picture of tomorrow, and tomorrow is either a threat or a table.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 适 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 逃 ingqe eqhuma, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child believes the sentence more than the apology that follows it. Speak as if the sentence will live in them, because it will. This is not fear. It is care.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逃 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 逅 ingqe eqhuma, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The ordinary work, the meal, the repaired hinge, the repeated story, is the curriculum of a family. Thank the labor, not the performance of being easy to live with.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 逅 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 逆 ingqe eqhuma, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A child does not need a conversation performed. A child needs a person who can be found. Being findable is the practice. The words can come later, or not.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, phezulu, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 逆 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 逈 ingqe eqhuma, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Forgiveness does not require the betrayed to be foolish. It requires them to decide whether the person is still a member. Membership is a practice after it has been a wound.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逈 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 逋 ingqe eqhuma, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A marriage that has lost a child, or a parent, or a future, needs presence more than explanation. Explanation is a way of leaving. Sitting is a way of staying.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逋 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 逌 ingqe eqhuma, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A marriage in despair does not need a speech about gratitude. It needs one true plan for tomorrow that both people can bear. Make the plan small enough to be kept.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 逌 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 逍 ingqe eqhuma, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
In a marriage, revenge is often petty and therefore easy to excuse. The small cut, repeated, is how love is replaced by a contest. Mercy is leaving one cut unanswered.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 逍 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 逎 ingqe eqhuma, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逎 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 透 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 透 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 逐 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 逐 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 逑 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 逑 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 逓 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逓 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 途 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 途 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 逕 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 逕 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 逖 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 逖 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 逗 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逗 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 這 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 這 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 逝 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 逝 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 逞 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 逞 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 速 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 速 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 造 ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 造 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 逡 ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 逡 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 逢 ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 逢 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

z: 連 ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 連 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 逧 ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逧 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 逭 ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 逭 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 逮 ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 逮 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 週 ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 週 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 進 ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work between siblings. ingqe eqhuma, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 進 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 逵 imisipha, izintambo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逵 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

z: 逶 imisipha, izintambo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 逶 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 逷 imisipha, izintambo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 逷 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 逸 imisipha, izintambo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逸 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 逹 imisipha, izintambo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 逹 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 逼 imisipha, izintambo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 逼 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 逾 imisipha, izintambo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 逾 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 遁 imisipha, izintambo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 遁 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: If you gave someone a cruel name, retire it today, out loud, and do not use it again.

z: 遂 imisipha, izintambo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 遂 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 遃 imisipha, izintambo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work between siblings. imisipha, izintambo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 遃 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 遄 imisipha, izintambo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

line:
In a marriage, the punishing quiet can last longer than a blow, and it teaches the same lesson: you are alone in this room. Presence refuses to teach that.

z: 邑 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Name the break once, plainly, without the extra charges that make you feel righteous. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and do it again tomorrow. Trust is rebuilt at that size.

z: 邕 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Do not correct a grieving person into cheer. Bring food. Take the lower seat. Let the name of the absent be said. The name is how the absent remain in the family.

line:
Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it. The gesture is small, and it is the whole teaching.

z: 邙 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Do one undeserved kindness to the person you are keeping score against. Do not mention the score. The mention would turn the kindness back into a move.

line:
The counsel that lasted did not flatter rage. It asked the strong to become a wall for the weak. That is the ethic of a parent and of an elder: your size is a shelter, or it is a threat.

practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

line:
The old wisdom is severe on the high seat. It is not severe on the upright spine. Stand up. Then let the others stand. A house of one standing person is a court, not a family.

practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 邢 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child who is envied by a parent carries a weight no child can name. Admiration from above is a kind of safety. It says, your becoming does not threaten my place.

practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 邦 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
A child learns courage from a body that does not abandon the feeling. Sit until the breath slows. Explanation can wait. Presence cannot.

line:
Children do not need every desire answered. They need to see a hand open. The open hand is their picture of tomorrow, and tomorrow is either a threat or a table.

line:
A child believes the sentence more than the apology that follows it. Speak as if the sentence will live in them, because it will. This is not fear. It is care.

practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 邰 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The ordinary work, the meal, the repaired hinge, the repeated story, is the curriculum of a family. Thank the labor, not the performance of being easy to live with.

practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 邱 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child does not need a conversation performed. A child needs a person who can be found. Being findable is the practice. The words can come later, or not.

practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 邳 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Forgiveness does not require the betrayed to be foolish. It requires them to decide whether the person is still a member. Membership is a practice after it has been a wound.

practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 邵 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A marriage that has lost a child, or a parent, or a future, needs presence more than explanation. Explanation is a way of leaving. Sitting is a way of staying.
